title: Unit logo grid
description: A calm customer grid on white: six wordmarks across two rows on desktop, three across four rows on phones, each cell with a tiny grey chevron dot in its corner when it links to a story. Some cells quietly hand over to a second name and back, blurring out and scaling in from 80%, staggered across the grid. Hovering a cell tints it and turns the dot white.
notes: names are typeset in the theme's fonts (bold, regular, caps, italic, mono) in place of real logos
CSS only; with reduced motion each cell keeps its first name
